name: glitchr/omnischolar
description: Omnischolar: one contract for a researcher's publications - author profiles, works, books and their editions, citations - read from OpenAlex, HAL, Crossref, ORCID, Open Library, arXiv and INSPIRE, merged and deduplicated, exported as BibTeX, RIS or CSL-JSON; and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnischolar/hal: HAL: French open archive, filtered by domain (shs.droit)
suggest.omnischolar/orcid: ORCID: identity, positions and degrees, declared works
suggest.omnischolar/inspire: INSPIRE-HEP: high-energy physics literature and citations
suggest.ext-intl: Better title matching across accents in the Merger
